podcast.body: This chart-topper in 2009 was succeeded at number one by The Black Eyed Peas' even bigger hit, "I Gotta Feeling," signaling their imperial peak. "The Black Eyed Peas were at their Imperial Peak in 2009, when their chart-topper, Boom Boom Pow, gave way to their even bigger number one smash, I got a feeling."

podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 2009, spending 12 weeks at number one on the Hot 100. It was one of two consecutive number ones for the group, led by will.i.am and Fergie, and was followed by "I Gotta Feeling" (14 weeks at #1). "Boom Boom Pow" captured a pivotal moment as 2000s hip hop transitioned into 2010s EDM dance pop. "Boom boom pow not only spent 12 big weeks at number one in 2009 it was one of two consecutive number ones by the Black Eyed Peas the Altrap turned hip pop hit makers led by Will I am and Fergie."
